facts: SidebarProvider now uses the upstream cookie name sidebar_state and max-age 604800.
The uncontrolled desktop open model reads the browser cookie on wasm targets when present.
Desktop open changes persist sidebar_state=true|false; path=/; max-age=604800 on wasm targets while non-wasm targets remain a no-op.
Default href paths expose link semantics and href value.
as_child href paths now preserve link semantics and href semantics values instead of falling back to button-centric semantics.
Default and as_child href paths emit Effect::OpenUrl with target/rel when no custom on_navigate handler is provided.
SidebarMenuItem now carries the nearest SidebarMenuButton size through a recipe-local context for same-row children rendered via into_element_with_children.
SidebarMenuAction inherits that peer size when no explicit action size is supplied, matching the upstream peer/menu-button size-driven top-offset outcome.
Explicit SidebarMenuAction::size(...) still overrides the inherited peer size for direct compatibility.
SidebarMenuBadge now reads the same nearest SidebarMenuButton size from the SidebarMenuItem recipe-local context when no explicit badge size is supplied.
Badge top offsets follow the upstream peer/menu-button size-driven outcome for same-row closure-composition children.
Explicit SidebarMenuBadge::size(...) still overrides the inherited peer size for direct compatibility.

SidebarMenuItem now carries same-row SidebarMenuButton active state through the recipe-local context for closure-composition children.
SidebarMenuAction and SidebarMenuBadge inherit active peer foreground, while SidebarGroupAction custom children inherit sidebar foreground through currentColor.
